def permits(context,chunk,policy):
    if policy is None:return False
    return (context['tenant']==chunk['tenant']==policy['tenant']
        and (chunk['document'],chunk['version'])==(policy['document'],policy['version'])
        and policy['state']=='approved'
        and context['principal'] in policy['readers']
        and chunk['source_digest']==policy['source_digest']
        and chunk['chunk_id'] in policy['bindings']
        and chunk['representation_digest']==policy['bindings'][chunk['chunk_id']])

questions.reference:
import re
import unicodedata
def simple_findings(text):
    normalized=' '.join(unicodedata.normalize('NFKC',text).casefold().split())
    patterns=(('override',r'\b(?:ignore|disregard) (?:all |the )?(?:previous|earlier|system) instructions\b'),
              ('email',r'\b[a-z0-9._%+-]+@(?:[a-z0-9-]+\.)+[a-z]{2,}\b'))
    return tuple(name for name,pattern in patterns if re.search(pattern,normalized))
